wineGlass.sourceTitle: Vietnamese Food in Hanoi | The Lounge
wineGlass.evidenceText: The exact Hanoi public menu's Red River section lists red wines by Glass: Kendall Jackson Vintner’s Reserve 910,000 VND, Campo AI Sassi Rosso Di Montalcino 650,000 VND, and D’Arenberg The Laughing Magpie 530,000 VND. The menu labels these servings Glass (the protocol's explicit-standard-glass alternative); no numeric pour volume is printed. The wine note states prices do not include VAT and a 5% service charge.
